title: Identifying a Critical Blind Spot: How Commercial AI (CAD) Systems Fail to Detect Faint Ground-Glass Opacities at -730 HU on Low-Dose CT.
summary: Primary cohort false negatives were 13/100 and 14/100; missed GGOs averaged −737 and −727 HU. In the external cohort, missed-GGO means were −741 and −733 HU. Vendor A used a 3D CNN CAD system and Vendor B a hybrid machine-learning/deep-learning system; both processed LDCT cases against three-radiologist consensus. Testing: A separate retrospective 50-patient cohort and three-radiologist consensus reference corroborated failures; findings are limited to the two tested products and study sites.. Two commercial CT CAD systems missed 13–14% of reference nodules in a 100-case cohort; faint GGOs missed near −730 HU were also observed in a separate 50-case external cohort. This is a bounded failure-analysis result, not a general estimate for all systems. Source affiliation was not stated in the reviewed case checks and was unavailable in the local bibliographic cache.
